questTitle: Run a Half Marathon on my 39th bday
statusStatement: Another interval-training session is reported complete toward the half marathon. Completion of this week’s long run and two-run target is not established.
whatMattersNow: Establish whether this week’s long run and two-run routine have been completed.
outcomeStatement: By 20 Nov 2026, I run a half marathon on my 39th birthday while re-establishing a sustainable baseline of one long run and one interval run each week.
quote: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.

statusStatement: The fence was previously recorded as complete, and a driveway quote has been requested. Quote receipt or acceptance and the remaining gate, overkapping, driveway, and carport work are unconfirmed.
whatMattersNow: Confirm the status of the requested driveway quote.
outcomeStatement: I have a finished, functional outdoor area with the fence and gate installed, a designed and built overkapping, and completed driveway and carport ground.
quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.

statusStatement: Bike hangers have been installed and the bikes are hung, adding to previously reported TV and speaker mounting. Lighting, electrical finishing, ventilation, audiovisual testing, and future-rower space remain unconfirmed or outstanding.
whatMattersNow: Complete the outstanding lighting and electrical finishing.
outcomeStatement: I have a finished, clean, motivating Zwift-focused garage gym with working TV, sound, electrics, ventilation, lighting, and space for a future rower.
quote: The details are not the details. They make the design.

statusStatement: A materials pickup is reported, but the items are unspecified. No installation or finishing task is newly confirmed complete.
whatMattersNow: Confirm whether the picked-up materials include the awaited handwashing furniture and wall plates.
outcomeStatement: I have a completely finished downstairs toilet with working ventilation and lighting, finished walls and niche, installed handwashing furniture, and clean final details throughout.
quote: Have nothing in your house that you do not know to be useful, or believe to be beautiful.

statusStatement: Today’s food and drink report does not establish a calorie surplus or body-fat setback, and the planned bike ride remains unchecked. Sustained six-hour training weeks and progress toward 12% body fat cannot be assessed without Workouts totals and a new Withings measurement.
whatMattersNow: Establish current weekly Workouts totals and a current Withings body-fat measurement.
outcomeStatement: I train at least six hours per week on a sustained basis, using Workouts as the source of truth, and reduce body fat from approximately 16% to 12% as measured by my Withings Body Scan.
quote: Physical fitness is the first requisite of happiness.
